source: Alpha Vantage NEWS_SENTIMENT filtered for JPM
anti_leakage_rule: Each article is assigned to the first JPM trading day strictly after its UTC publication date. Weekend and holiday news rolls forward.
missing_news_rule: No-news trading days receive article_count=0, sentiment=0, and news_available_lag1=0.
disclosures: Alpha Vantage sentiment is an external vendor score.
UTC calendar-day mapping is conservative and avoids same-day after-close leakage.
A zero score on no-news days means no observed JPM article, not proven neutral sentiment.
